scope: Five opt-in native preference dimensions, durable saved-search ranking and explanation readback. Entire original requirements remain PARTIAL.

environment.frontend: isolated copied dependencies; Vitest 5.0.3 and Vite 8.3.1

acceptance: Title, annual-USD salary overlap, work arrangement, employment type and supported remote-region fit use the same deterministic profile/job evidence as the base explanation.
Source-provided specialized scores cannot override these native personal-fit dimensions. Missing, unsupported or malformed evidence remains UNKNOWN, excluded from the denominator.
Explicitly enabled known matches contribute 100/100; supported direct preference mismatches contribute 0/100. These are advisory preferences, not candidate qualification or hard-eligibility findings.
The real fixture ranking is aligned=75, unknown=50, mismatch=35. Scores and exact contribution/provenance readback survive Store disposal and reopening against the same SQLite file.
Connected Chromium edits all six weights, saves, reloads and reads the real persisted 75/100 explanation with native provenance. No outside request or forbidden write is observed.
Other-profile reads return 404; stale configuration returns 409 until recalculation; stale edits do not mutate state. Candidate facts, hard filters and the other saved search remain unchanged.
No profile salary bounds, desired-role strings, addresses or source-supplied personal-fit provenance are echoed in the added contribution explanations.

checks.note: TypeScript and Vite production build. JavaScript bundle 783.85 kB; no optimization claim.

checks.command: python -m compileall -q [touched Python paths]; lane_coordination validate; git diff --check

red_first.purpose: Before implementation, native preference weights did not use personal evidence and source scores could override them.

limitations: No canonical acceptance or progress tracker mutation: another session holds the integration lock; TRACKER_REFRESH_PENDING.
This is branch acceptance, not main integration or full MJ-REQ-117/MJ-REQ-114 PASS.
Supported title/currency/region comparisons remain deliberately bounded. On-site commute, work authorization, salary negotiation, certification and education weighting are not newly accepted.
Full Python repository suite, PostgreSQL, external employer/ATS, hosted CI and independent delegated review NOT_RUN.
Local deterministic tests used Node 25.9.0; no broader runtime support certification is claimed.
